top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a quantitative, falsifiable prediction (Bistritzer-MacDonald flat bands at a magic twist angle) and the 2018 discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states, since checked by spectroscopy and reproduced by many independent groups and carried into other moire platforms; neither half depends on a settled pairing mechanism. The allocation (MacDonald, Bistritzer, Jarillo-Herrero) pairs theory with experiment, though the omission of Yuan Cao and the earlier band-structure work, plus the field's youth, are real costs. P002 is the more mature and cleanly attributed result and my fallback, but it is closer to a measurement achievement in a lineage already honoured in 2005 and 2012. Some award is better than none.
